body.statement: For every \(d\in\mathfrak D_{n,B}\), \(\widehat\tau_d\) is unbiased for \(\tau\) and \[\mathcal R_{n,B}(d;\mu,\sigma)=V^*(\sigma)\sum_{b=1}^B\frac{(w_b-t_b)^2}{t_b}+\sum_{b=1}^B\frac{w_b^2}{t_b}\,\mathbb E_{P^{d}_{\mu,\sigma}}[r_\sigma(p_b)].\]
body.justification: This identity exposes weight mismatch and chronological allocation regret as the only two sources of design loss.
body.gap: Li and Simchi-Levi decompose feasible-estimator error, and Dai, Gradu, and Harshaw connect Neyman regret to variance, but neither identity retains exact-count batch grids and arbitrary deterministic batch weights.
body.consumer: It turns an update-cadence choice in the Amazon adaptive-abtester workflow into two auditable cost components.
